entities.summary: Inca, a notable figure in the history of Peru, associated with The Spanish Conquest and Fall of the Inca (1533–1572). Preceded by Manco Inca's Great Rebellion and Pizarro captures Atahualpa at Cajamarca — November 16, 1532. Their legacy influenced Manco Inca's Great Rebellion besieges Cusco and Túpac Amaru I executed in Cusco — 1572, end of Inca resistance.
